## Análisis de Tendencias

```{python}
#| echo: false
import plotly.express as px
df = px.data.gapminder().query("year == 2007")
fig = px.scatter(df, x="gdpPercap", y="lifeExp", size="pop", color="continent", hover_name="country", log_x=True, size_max=60)
fig.show()
```
